decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be began not later than the expiration of five years beginning with the date of this consent.
Condition : 2 - All new internal and external works, including works of making good, shall match the original work in both type, colour and dimension of materials and in detailed execution.

Condition : 3 - A schedule for all new windows and doors at scale 1:20 (to include sections) be submitted and agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the commence of works and the approved details shall be implemented and maintained thereafter.

Condition : 4 - 4.	Full details of the following:
a)	the extent of repairs to the front metal windows to include a method of statement for each window
b)	new pointing and brickwork repairs
c)	the roof terrace, handrails and access housing at scale 1:5

be submitted and agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the commence of works and the approved details shall be implemented and maintained thereafter.

Condition : 5 - Sample panels of cleaned brickwork giving details of the method shall be provided on site and approved by the Local Planning Authority before the works are commenced and the sample panels shall be retained on site until the work is completed and has been approved.

Condition : 6 - The depth of the proposed balconies is considered unsatisfactory in the form shown on the drawings submitted to date and this aspect of the scheme should be modified to ensure that the depth is reduced to 500mm.  Details of the balconies shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the works are commenced.
description: Remove paint from river fascade and repainting new balconies to living room and bedroom with new windows, new roof deck and access dormer, replacement roof beam, spiral staircase, replacement cills and refurbishment of timber / cast iron windows, creation of river room / bedroom and construction of granite kerb to forecourt boundary (Listed Building)
